criteria.criterion: Neutral starter has no live identity/branch set, standing grant, schedule or autonomous-write permission.
Missing, malformed, expired or incompatible selections produce precise unavailable/blocked diagnostics.
Project specialization is capability-only; standing entitlements remain absent until deliberately accepted at adoption.
AGENTS.md, README sections, generated wiki and Task responses have distinct owners and update routes.
Overrides, generators, stable identities and protected sections resolve conservatively; unknown/mixed targets hold unsafe edits.
Grants bind actor/project/branch/policy/source/payload/scope/owner and freshness; valid standing entitlements avoid redundant approval.
Candidate-controlled code and environment cannot alter broker policy, credentials or effective approval logic.
Broker routes canonical mutations to their existing helper owners and rejects arbitrary shell instructions.
Caller identity comes from the trusted native request envelope and current manager binding, not an actor string in model arguments; workers cannot read private grants or broker credentials.
One controller/charter is selected per execution; reading a charter does not activate it.
Specialist responsibilities, qualifications, role reads, scope and stopping rules are explicit; generic Director use and category rules are preserved.
New provenance is schema-versioned and validated; historical records retain bytes/meaning and unknown fields are rejected.
Curator bootstrap reserves exactly one manager, activates only the real receipt identity and relinquishes canonical Task writing.
Existing record/configuration schemas keep their meaning; any changed grant envelope has explicit version dispatch.
Only the current confirmed manager with exact operation scope can publish Curator knowledge; ordinary workers and forged provenance fail.
Activation, manager/child discovery, supervision, interrupt and resume observations are mapped without forging collaboration receipts.
Effective model/effort and independent contexts are checked; missing capabilities hold work.
Real observations establish identities, reservation-before-launch, one canonical writer, full required teams, settings inheritance and isolated solver input.
Capacity queuing preserves every required agent; uncertain or absent observations are named non-passes.
Candidate writes to trusted policy/broker, canonical ledgers, control records, grants and credentials are denied by the enforced boundary.
Malicious branch/diff/note/config, process execution and broker-request cases cannot gain authority or bypass publication.
